title: mris_convert
description: This program will convert MRI-surface data formats.

second_input_file.description: Second input filename to be combined, required for --combinesurfs
second_input_file.title: Second input file

patch.description: Input file is a patch file, not a full surface
patch.title: Patch flag

functional_data_file.description: Input functional time-series or other multi-frame data
functional_data_file.title: Functional data file

rescale.description: Rescale vertex xyz so total area is same as group average
rescale.title: Rescale flag

talairach_xfm.description: Apply talairach xfm of subject to vertex xyz
talairach_xfm.title: Talairach xfm

normals.description: Output ascii file where vertex data is the surface normal vector
normals.title: Normals flag

neighbors.description: Write out neighbors of a vertex in each row
neighbors.title: Neighbors flag

xyz.description: Print only surface xyz to ascii file
xyz.title: XYZ flag

annotation_file.description: Input annotation or gifti label data
annotation_file.title: Annotation file

parcstats_file.description: Input text file containing label/val pairs for parcellation
parcstats_file.title: Parcstats file

gifti_dataarray_num.description: Input gifti dataarray number to use
gifti_dataarray_num.title: Gifti dataarray number

label_file.description: Input .label file and name for this label
label_file.title: Label file

label_stats_file.description: Output gifti file to which label stats will be written
label_stats_file.title: Label stats file

combine_surfs.description: Combine surface files, two input surface files required
combine_surfs.title: Combine surfaces flag

merge_gifti.description: Generate combined gifti file with surface and multiple curvature data
merge_gifti.title: Merge gifti flag

split_gifti.description: Separate surface and data array from combined gifti file
split_gifti.title: Split gifti flag

gifti_outdir.description: Output directory for generated gifti files
gifti_outdir.title: Gifti output directory

vol_geom.description: Use MRIVol to set the volume geometry
vol_geom.title: Volume geometry

remove_vol_geom.description: Set the valid flag in vg to 0
remove_vol_geom.title: Remove volume geometry flag

to_surf.description: Copy coordinates from surfcoords to output (good for patches)
to_surf.title: To surface coordinates

to_scanner.description: Convert coordinates from native FS (tkr) coords to scanner coords
to_scanner.title: To scanner flag

to_tkr.description: Convert coordinates from scanner coords to native FS (tkr) coords
to_tkr.title: To TKR flag

upsample.description: Upsample N times by splitting edges/faces
upsample.title: Upsample times

label_to_mask.description: Convert a surface-based label to a binary mask
label_to_mask.title: Label to mask surface

cras_add.description: Shift center to scanner coordinate center
cras_add.title: CRAS Add flag

cras_subtract.description: Shift center from scanner coordinate center
cras_subtract.title: CRAS Subtract flag
